answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. A saffron of per-task receipts records who did what, and the plume of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the island of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
